// $Id: ldelay4.v,v 1.3 2007/12/06 02:31:10 stevewilliams Exp $

// Test for delays in structural logic.  Differential clock receiver UDP.

module test;

   wire q, e;
   reg  a, b;
   drec #1 rec(q, a, b);
   edet det (e, q);

   reg	error;
   initial
     begin
	error = 0;
	#2;
	forever @(e)
	  if (e !== 1'bx) begin // Fail on anything other then x.
	     error = 1;
	     $display("%0d: FAILED: e=%b", $time, e);
	  end
     end

   always @(q)
     $display("%d: q=%b", $time, q);

   initial
     begin
//	$dumpvars;
	a = 0;
	b = 1;
	#3;
	a = 1;
	b = 0;
	#2;
	a = 0;
	b = 1;
	#3;
	if (!error)
	  $display("PASSED");
     end
endmodule

// differential receiver

primitive drec (q, a, b);
   output        q;
   input  a, b;
   table
          1  0 : 1 ;
          0  1 : 0 ;
   endtable
endprimitive

// flag any edges to or from 'bx

primitive edet (q, i);
   output           q;
   input  i;
   reg	        q;
   table
         (?x) : ? : 1;
         (x?) : ? : 0;
   endtable
endprimitive
